text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day while searching for Air<n>Shakur, I find her
taking a rare nap,<n>her laptop still open.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I go to close her laptop, the screen<n>catches my
eye. It looks like she had<n>her social media open.
The account<n>on-screen says "!monad."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, this is an account<n>she uses to
post music she makes.<n>I'm a little surprised by her
choice of<n>hobby, but decide to leave before she
wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I decide to invite Air<n>Shakur to the
record shop.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I fully expected her to say no, but it<n>seems she
already had plans to<n>come here. She's allowed me
to tag<n>along—but nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Man, you never learn, huh. Remember<n>what
happened at the net cafe?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Once we're at the shop, don't you<n>dare talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This artist's not even that big, so why<n>a physical
CD? If they'd just posted<n>it online, I could've
bought it with a<n>single click.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's come here today to<n>buy the CD of
a small-time artist.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not really. But it is good for drowning<n>out the
thoughts in my head.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: Next up is my newest song, "Rust."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur stops in her tracks. I follow<n>her line of
sight to find a young<n>woman performing on her DJ
deck.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Her CD is what I came here to buy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Didn't think I'd get to listen to her<n>live today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, Air Shakur finds a spot a bit<n>separated
from the artist and begins<n>to listen to her
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The song's rhythm seems to draw<n>you in, and the
scat vocals add a<n>sense of playfulness to the
experience. Before I know it, I'm<n>tapping my foot to
the beat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it's not bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Most of her stuff online is really light<n>and old
school... Looks like she<n>switched genres to house
music.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, change is inevitable after all.<n>Let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Please take this!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The young musician hands a single<n>flyer to Air
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I'm still pretty new to the game, but<n>I'll be
performing at this event! Feel<n>free to drop by if you
can!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Got it. Huh, so it's this<n>weekend—ah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taking a peek at the flyer, my eyes<n>settle on the
artist's profile, which<n>explains she was inspired to
perform<n>after hearing a certain artist... !monad.

text_block_list.name: Young Musician
text_block_list.text: Um, 'scuse me... is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's fine. Good luck this<n>weekend.
choice_data_list: Who's this DJ listed in your profile?
Who's this DJ listed in your profile?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, them! I love, love, LOVE !monad's<n>stuff! I have
to be extra careful to not<n>copy their style
completely.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I ended up using scat vocals hoping<n>to make the
song feel mine... But well,<n>I'm definitely still working
out the<n>kinks in my style!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!monad's music sounds like<n>they're just
messing around to me. I<n>doubt it's got any use as
inspiration<n>or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on, don't say that! I owe<n>!monad my
life!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Your life?

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean that literally or anything.<n>It's not like
we've ever met. But...

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: I'm just... different from other people,and my life's been pretty hard'cause of it. But even when I tried tofit in, it's like something was still off,ya know?

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
But that's when I heard !monad's<n>music, and it felt
like someone was<n>sticking the middle finger to the
world!<n>It gave me the push I needed to do<n>things my
way!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
But all that aside, their musical sense<n>alone is on
another level! They're like<n>a bat out of hell,
screaming bloody<n>murder! They're truly living in the
moment!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: I'd love to meet them myself oneday. I just know that deep down,they've got a heart burning with passion!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What're you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Several days later...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! Someone put a<n>super flashy flyer
on the bulletin<n>board! You think a student did it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Probably. But wait, isn't this for a club<n>in town?
Huh... Maybe I'll check it<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious flyer posted on the<n>school bulletin
board quickly becomes<n>the talk of the academy.
